Hi Team





We need SME to coach one of the team on Oracle Exadata Cloud at Customer (ExaCC) Container Database (CDB) / Pluggable Database (PDB) rehost migrations on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).



The scope is a multitenant rehost (lift-and-shift) into ExaCC with controlled downtime and a tested fallback.



Required scope is as follows:



  *   Plan and execute CDB/PDB rehost to ExaCC using Oracle-native approaches:

     *   PDB Unplug/Plug between source CDB and target ExaCC CDB.

     *   Oracle Recovery Manager (RMAN) duplicate/restore where appropriate.

     *   Oracle Data Pump (expdp/impdp — Export Data Pump/Import Data Pump) for schema/data movement and metadata alignment.

     *   Optional Oracle GoldenGate (OGG) for change data capture to reduce cutover downtime.

  *   Readiness for networking, storage, and security:

     *   Virtual Cloud Network (VCN)

     *   Automatic Storage Management (ASM) layout and capacity planning.

     *   Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles, least-privilege access, and secrets handling.

  *   Observability and performance:

     *   Automatic Workload Repository (AWR) / Active Session History (ASH) baselines, compare pre/post.

     *   Optional Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM) Cloud Control integration.

  *   Cutover governance: rehearsals, runbooks, rollback, and hypercare (post go-live support).



Engagement model



  *   Knowledge Transfer (KT): 4–6 deep-dive sessions with live demos and Questions and Answers (Q&A).

  *   Hands-on Workshop: 3–6 days to walk through plan → rehearse → execute on a pilot.

  *   Shadow Support: SME guides one production cutover end-to-end.



Required skill set



  *   Proven Oracle multitenant (CDB/PDB) migrations to Oracle Exadata Cloud at Customer (ExaCC) on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

  *   Hands-on with PDB Unplug/Plug, Oracle Recovery Manager (RMAN), Oracle Data Pump (expdp/impdp); working knowledge of Oracle GoldenGate (OGG) for low-downtime cutovers.

  *   Performance tuning using Automatic Workload Repository (AWR) / Active Session History (ASH); capacity planning on Automatic Storage Management (ASM).

  *   Familiar with Identity and Access Management (IAM), Virtual Cloud Network (VCN).



Could you please let us know if you have any experts available who can help us deliver this.

We look forward to your suggestions and appreciate your support.

Dear Hiring / Talent Acquisition Leader,



I am reaching out to explore whether your recruitment team is currently

facing *pipeline quality, interview dropouts, or over-dependence on job

portals*—issues that have intensified across India and global hiring

markets in 2025–2026.



This email serves as a *concise training cover letter*, outlining *why most

recruitment teams underperform*, how this program fixes the *root causes*,

and how you can *submit a training request* if relevant.





*INTRODUCTION *



I am *GS Kumar*, Founder & Principal Advisor for Recruitment Excellence,

with *20+ years of hands-on hiring leadership* across staffing firms and

corporate talent acquisition teams in India and global markets.



I have personally trained and advised 11*,000+ Professionals & recruiters,

HR leaders, and delivery teams*, focusing on *execution-level hiring

outcomes*—not theory. My work centers on reducing wrong hires, improving

interview-to-offer conversion, cutting job portal dependency, and upgrading

recruiters from *resume processors to hiring consultants*.



My programs are designed for *real hiring pressure*: volume targets, niche

skills, delivery timelines, and client accountability.

------------------------------



*Founder’s Podcast – Hiring, Careers & Market Reality*



I have also been featured on the *Founder’s Podcast*, where I discuss real

hiring failures, recruiter capability gaps, and how leadership teams can

fix recruitment ROI at scale:



🎧 Founder’s Podcast Episode:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dnUukpDy1gA



This conversation reflects the *same frameworks and market realities* used

in the training outlined below.





------------------------------

Recruitment Market Reality – 2025 - 2026



Across staffing firms and corporate TA teams, the most common hiring

failures are:



• 60–70% duplicate or irrelevant resumes from job portals

• Recruiters operating as callers, not hiring consultants

• Poor interview-to-offer conversion

• High offer dropouts and wrong-hire risk



*Industry benchmarks (SHRM & LinkedIn Talent Insights):*

• Cost of a wrong hire = *30–50% of annual CTC*

• Higher recruiter fatigue with no proportional closures

• Missed delivery timelines and client dissatisfaction

• Escalating portal costs with declining ROI

• Loss of credibility with candidates and hiring managers



One wrong hire at ₹12 LPA typically costs *₹3.6–₹6 lakhs*—often more than

the *entire annual training budget*.

THE SOLUTION (Recruitment Training – Execution Focused)

+ niche hiring*, built around real recruiter workflows.

   • Consulting-style questioning frameworks

   *Recruiter Calling Script – PPC Method*

   • Problem → Pitch → Close

   • Higher candidate trust & response rate

   *AI for Recruiters (2026-Ready)*

   • ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok for:

Hi Team,

Greetings.

We have received a training requirement for SharePoint Online focused on governance, standardization, and operational excellence for an existing client team. We are looking to engage experienced trainers or training partners who can support this engagement.

Training Requirement – Overview

Tentative Start Date: February – 2nd week

Mode of Delivery: Online / Instructor-led

Duration & Time Zone:



  *

3–4 hours per day

  *

German time zone (sessions to be conducted mostly in IST evenings)



Number of Participants: 5+

Session Recording: Required for all sessions

Training Material: Trainer to share PPTs and supporting materials with participants

Problem Statement

Post migration, the SharePoint environment has expanded significantly with hundreds of sites, leading to:



  *

Inconsistent sharing and permission models

  *

Over-reliance on individual file/folder sharing instead of group-based access

  *

Confusion due to multiple site types (classic, modern, team-connected, private, shared-channel)

  *

Many unused or stale sites with no clear archiving strategy

  *

Legacy permissions and entries requiring cleanup

  *

Limited in-house SharePoint expertise



Overall Goal:

To establish strong governance, standardization, and internal capability for managing SharePoint Online and related Microsoft 365 services.

Expected Training Scope / Topics

1. Core SharePoint Foundations



  *

SharePoint Online architecture

  *

Site types and permission models

  *

Lists, libraries, pages, metadata, and content types



2. Administration & Management



  *

SharePoint Admin Center

  *

Site provisioning and storage management

  *

Term store management

  *

External sharing controls and audit logs



3. Governance & Compliance (Key Focus Area)



  *

Site lifecycle and archival strategies

  *

Naming conventions and information architecture

  *

Permissions governance

  *

Data retention, labeling, and DLP basics

  *

Managing site sprawl



4. Content & Document Management



  *

Library design and metadata models

  *

Versioning and records management

  *

Large library handling best practices



5. Automation & Enhancements



  *

Power Automate workflows

  *

PnP PowerShell for provisioning and reporting

  *

Automating governance and admin tasks



6. Security & Access Control



  *

RBAC and external access management

  *

Sensitivity labels

  *

Integration with Conditional Access and Microsoft Defender



7. Operational Excellence



  *

Daily, weekly, and monthly admin activities

  *

Troubleshooting and incident management

  *

Support model and SOPs



8. Modern Experience & Integrations



  *

Modern SharePoint pages

  *

Teams and SharePoint integration

  *

Viva and departmental portals



Expected Deliverables



  *

Governance framework

  *

Site provisioning SOP

  *

Permissions matrix

  *

Naming conventions

  *

Operational runbook

HI Team,



This training can also be in English but we are looking for a trainer please let us know if you can help us





We have an urgent training requirement for one of our Japanese associate. Could you pls help us with the quotation for below:







  *   Virtual Instructor-Led Training (VILT) for an individual associate



  *   Additionally, it would be helpful if you could provide quotations for both the raw content and the digitized version.





Below are the curriculum details for your reference:







Complete Training Curriculum for Medical Device Japan Regulatory Requirements







📌 Module 1: Introduction to Japan’s Regulatory Landscape



  *   Overview of Japan’s healthcare regulatory ecosystem

  *   Role of PAL (Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Act)

  *   Scope and legal authority

  *   Comparison with EU MDR and US FDA







📌 Module 2: Regulatory Authorities & Their Responsibilities



MHLW



  *   Policy‑level responsibilities

  *   Final approval authority

  *   Market control, recalls, safety notices



PMDA



  *   Application review process

  *   QMS audit methodology

  *   Clinical data assessment

  *   Risk‑benefit evaluation

  *   Adverse event monitoring



Other Entities



  *   Registered Certification Bodies

  *   Local government regulatory roles

  *   Regional Bureaus

  *   Foreign Manufacturer Registration system







📌 Module 3: Medical Device Definitions & Classification



  *   Definition of medical devices in Japan

  *   JMDN (Japan Medical Device Nomenclature) overview

  *   Detailed classification criteria:

     *   Class I (General)

     *   Class II (Controlled)

     *   Class III/IV (Specially Controlled)

  *   Mapping between JMDN ↔ GMDN ↔ UDI identifiers







📌 Module 4: Pre‑Market Regulatory Pathways



  1.  Pre‑market Notification (Todokede)

  2.  Pre‑market Certification (Ninsho)

  3.  Pre‑market Approval – PMA‑equivalent (Shonin)



Training should cover:



  *   Required dossier content for each pathway

  *   When clinical data is mandatory

  *   Use of JIS standards vs ISO standards

  *   Role of STED format

  *   Human factors and biocompatibility requirements







📌 Module 5: Licensing Requirements



1. MAH System (Japan‑specific requirement)



  *   MAH obligations

  *   GVP (Good Vigilance Practice) requirements

  *   QMS (Quality Management System) oversight



2. Manufacturer licensing



  *   Foreign Manufacturer Registration (FMR)

  *   Domestic manufacturer licensing

  *   Distributor/importer responsibilities







📌 Module 6: Quality Management System Requirements



  *   Japan QMS Ordinance (aligned with ISO 13485 + Japan‑specific addendum)

  *   Annual audits & inspection readiness

  *   Documentation expectations

  *   Post‑market QMS obligations







📌 Module 7: Essential Principles (EP) & Safety/Performance Requirements



  *   Detailed walkthrough of the 6 General Requirements

  *   Design & Manufacturing requirements

  *   How PMDA evaluates EP conformity

  *   How EP maps to GHTF STED guidelines







📌 Module 8: Application Dossier Preparation



  *   STED: structure & content

  *   Labeling & IFU requirements (localized Japanese requirements)

  *   Risk management file (ISO 14971)

  *   Clinical evaluation (equivalency, bridging, local trials)

  *   Software device documentation (SaMD requirements)







📌 Module 9: Post‑Market Surveillance (PMS) & Vigilance



  *   AE reporting timelines and rules

  *   Foreign AE reporting obligations

  *   Recall classifications & procedures

  *   GVP obligations for MAH

  *   Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSUR equivalents, if applicable)







📌 Module 10: Third‑Party Certification & Inspections



  *   Roles of Registered Certification Bodies

  *   Evaluation of QMS compliance

  *   Follow‑up inspection process

  *   Handling objections & corrective actions







📌 Module 11: Labeling, Packaging & Unique Device Identification (UDI)



  *   Japanese labeling requirements

  *   Language requirements (Japanese mandatory)

  *   UDI system under PAL amendments

  *   Traceability expectations







📌 Module 12: Market Trends & Strategic Considerations



  *   Japan’s aging population and device demand

  *   Digital health and SaMD regulatory changes

  *   Fast‑track pathways (if applicable)

  *   Reimbursement landscape overview (Chuikyo)



Looking forward to hearing from you asap





Regards,

We have received a new requirement, and the details are provided below for your reference. We kindly request your support in sharing suitable trainer profiles along with the proposed course outline for the same.







We are exploring options to conduct an in‑person AI upskilling workshop for our Data Engineering team (10–15 participants) in Bangalore, and we would like to request your proposal and quotation.



About the participants



  *   Audience: Data Engineers / Senior Data Engineers

  *   Current stack: Azure, Databricks, Azure Data Factory (ADF), Azure Devops, Jenkins

  *   Focus: Enterprise‑grade data pipelines and platforms



Training Objectives

We are specifically interested in practical and applied use of AI for Data Engineering & Data Science, including (but not limited to):



  *   Using AI / GenAI to design or generate data pipelines based on functional and technical requirements

  *   Leveraging AI to analyze, detect, and measure data quality issues across pipelines

  *   Applying AI for pipeline observability, anomaly detection, and failure prediction

  *   AI‑assisted development and optimization in Azure Data Factory and Databricks

  *   Best practices, architecture patterns, and real‑world use cases relevant to enterprise data platforms

  *   AI agents creation and deployment in Azure



Logistics & Constraints



  *   Mode: In‑person (Bangalore)

  *   Duration: 2 to 3 full days

  *   Participants: 10–15



Request from your side



  1.  Proposed agenda / course outline (day‑wise)

  2.  Training methodology (hands‑on labs, demos, case studies, etc.)

  3.  Trainer profile(s)

  4.  Commercial quotation

  5.  Any prerequisites or setup required from participants



Please feel free to tailor the agenda specifically for Data Engineering & Data Science use cases on Azure & Databricks using AI & Agents, rather than generic AI or data science topics.

Java & Spring Boot on AWS

  *   Credential provider chain

  *   Centralized logging mindset

AMAZON S3 & DATA LAKE

Amazon S3 Core Concepts & Security



  *   Buckets, objects, prefixes



  *   Storage classes



  *   Strong consistency



  *   Bucket policies & IAM

S3 for Analytics & Data Lake Design

  *   Folder vs prefix design

RDS & Aurora Fundamentals



  *   RDS architecture



  *   Multi-AZ vs Read Replicas



  *   Backup & restore strategies



  *   Aurora architecture



  *   Writer vs reader endpoints



  *   Aurora Serverless overview

Spring Boot Integration & High Availability



  *   Spring Data JPA

  *   Transaction management

  *   Failover handling



  *   Hands-on: Spring Boot + Aurora, failover simulation





Schema Migration & Legacy DB Modernization

  *   Schema versioning

MESSAGING & EVENT-DRIVEN SYSTEMS

SNS → SQS integration

Hello Mounika,

I hope you are doing well.

This email is to formally communicate that you are being placed on a Performance Improvement Plan (PIP) effective February 11 through March 11.

Over the past few weeks, we have observed certain concerns that require immediate improvement. We want to clearly outline them so there is full transparency and alignment:

• Accountability and ownership of assigned tasks
• Timely completion of work commitments
• Taking leave without prior intimation or approval from management
• Missing foundational concepts despite repeated training support
• Raising concerns about expectations instead of proactively working on improvement
• Limited voluntary involvement in projects and additional responsibilities

At Clahan Technologies, we strongly believe in building a culture of ownership, honesty, self-motivation, and proactive contribution. We expect every team member to:

• Take complete responsibility for assigned deliverables
• Communicate clearly and proactively, especially regarding leaves or blockers
• Continuously improve technical fundamentals
• Demonstrate a positive and solution-oriented attitude
• Contribute new ideas and voluntarily participate in projects
• Show willingness to take additional responsibilities when required

This PIP period is intended to give you structured time and support to demonstrate measurable improvement in the above areas. We will review progress regularly during this period.

Please understand that this is a serious matter. If we do not observe significant improvement in attitude, accountability, and performance by March 11, we may have to reconsider the continuation of your employment with the organization.

Our intention is not to penalize but to help you succeed. We genuinely hope to see positive changes and growth during this period.

We are available to support you throughout this process. Let us work together to make this improvement journey successful.

Please acknowledge receipt of this email.

Best regards,
Murali Mohan
CEO & Founder
Clahan Technologies

There are two differet requirments:







Quote:



Need 1 — Incident Interrogation & Navigation Capability

As our firm scales, PSREs are increasingly required to drive incidents in unchartered territories where they may not have deep system expertise. Despite this, they are expected to lead war rooms, navigate ambiguity, follow frameworks/SLAs, and drive rapid resolution.







We’re looking to build capability around:



  *   Structured incident interrogation & questioning techniques

  *   Driving investigations without full system knowledge

  *   Navigating unknown architectures & dependencies

  *   Leading SMEs and coordinating resolution efforts

  *   Balancing speed with protocol adherence







Need 2 — Driving Stability Without Authority & Building Resilient Mindset

PSRE plays a key role in driving the firm’s stability roadmap; however, engineering/dev teams do not directly report into this function. This requires influencing without authority, pushing reliability priorities, and sustaining momentum through complex, non-linear challenges.







We’re looking to focus on:



  *   Influencing engineering teams toward stability outcomes

  *   Driving cross-team accountability for reliability

  *   Embedding a proactive resilience mindset

  *   Navigating resistance and competing priorities

  *   Sustaining effectiveness through high-pressure, atypical incidents

As our firm scales, PSREs are increasingly required to drive incidents in unchartered territories where they may not have deep system expertise. Despite this, they are expected to lead war rooms, navigate ambiguity, follow frameworks/SLAs, and drive rapid resolution.







We’re looking to build capability around:



  *   Structured incident interrogation & questioning techniques

  *   Driving investigations without full system knowledge

  *   Navigating unknown architectures & dependencies

  *   Leading SMEs and coordinating resolution efforts

  *   Balancing speed with protocol adherence







Need 2 — Driving Stability Without Authority & Building Resilient Mindset

PSRE plays a key role in driving the firm’s stability roadmap; however, engineering/dev teams do not directly report into this function. This requires influencing without authority, pushing reliability priorities, and sustaining momentum through complex, non-linear challenges.







We’re looking to focus on:



  *   Influencing engineering teams toward stability outcomes

  *   Driving cross-team accountability for reliability

  *   Embedding a proactive resilience mindset

  *   Navigating resistance and competing priorities

  *   Sustaining effectiveness through high-pressure, atypical incidents

Quote:

Need 1 — Incident Interrogation & Navigation Capability


As our firm scales, PSREs are increasingly required to drive incidents in unchartered territories where they may not have deep system expertise.

 Despite this, they are expected to lead war rooms, navigate ambiguity, follow frameworks/SLAs, and drive rapid resolution.

We’re looking to build capability around:

Structured incident interrogation & questioning techniques

Driving investigations without full system knowledge

Navigating unknown architectures & dependencies

Leading SMEs and coordinating resolution efforts

Balancing speed with protocol adherence

Need 2 — Driving Stability Without Authority & Building Resilient Mindset


PSRE plays a key role in driving the firm’s stability roadmap; however, engineering/dev teams do not directly report into this function. This

 requires influencing without authority, pushing reliability priorities, and sustaining momentum through complex, non-linear challenges.

We’re looking to focus on:

Influencing engineering teams toward stability outcomes

Driving cross-team accountability for reliability

Embedding a proactive resilience mindset

Navigating resistance and competing priorities

Sustaining effectiveness through high-pressure, atypical incidents

Hi Team,





We have a training requirement for multiple areas as mentioned below:







1. Db2 for z/OS Database Administration



2. Db2 for z/OS Utilities and Performance



3. Db2 13 Technical Overview



4. Database Administration



5. IBM Mainframe ZOS Fundamentals







Scope of the training is as follows:







  1.  Db2 for z/OS Database Administration

     *   Db2 for z/OS Database Administration training has to cover design, creation, security, performance, and recovery of enterprise databases.

     *   It has to prepare the professionals for both entry-level certification and advanced DBA responsibilities, ensuring they can manage mission-critical workloads on IBM mainframes.

  2.  Db2 for z/OS Utilities and Performance



     *   Db2 for z/OS Utilities

        *   Focuses on system facilities and core utilities for managing data sets, catalogs, and VSAM structures.

        *   Covers backup, restore, copy, and data manipulation tools essential for day‑to‑day system operations.

        *   Includes integration with system services like RACF security and Communications Server.

        *   Emphasizes problem determination and recovery services to maintain system reliability.

     *   Db2 for z/OS Performance

        *   Provides a foundation in performance metrics and monitoring tools (CPU, memory, I/O).

        *   Teaches Workload Manager (WLM) setup and workload distribution strategies.

        *   Focuses on I/O performance analysis, bottleneck detection, and capacity planning.

        *   Develops skills in performance tuning and problem diagnosis through case studies and practical exercises.



  1.  Db2 13 Technical Overview



     *   This training has to be designed for DBAs, system administrators, application developers, and IT decision makers

     *   It needs to provide them both a high‑level overview and the option for deep technical dives depending on role and expertise



  1.  Database administrator Training - Instructor led training by Software AG (Adabas)



     *   This training needs to build on knowledge of Adabas architecture and core concepts, ensuring administrators understand how the database functions within z/OS environments.

     *   This training needs to cover defining, maintaining, and monitoring Adabas databases. Includes tasks such as configuring parameters, managing files, and handling system catalogs.

     *   This training needs to train utilities for backup, restore, data movement, and performance monitoring. Emphasis on using Software AG tools effectively for daily operations.

     *   This training needs to Techniques for tuning Adabas databases, detecting bottlenecks, and ensuring efficient resource usage.

     *   This training needs to focus on safeguarding data, managing user access, and ensuring high availability through recovery procedures.



  1.  IBM Mainframe ZOS Fundamental Training



     *   Understand the fundamentals of IBM mainframes and z/OS

     *   Gain practical skills in job submission, data management, and system utilities

     *

Be prepared to support enterprise workloads with awareness of security and performance considerations

Dear Ms. Annapurna,



Greetings of the day!

We are pleased to introduce Cranes Varsity’s domain-specific corporate training solutions, designed to bridge skill gaps, accelerate workforce readiness, and align employee capabilities with real-world industry demands.



With over two decades of experience in industry-aligned training, Cranes Varsity partners with organizations across Embedded Systems, VLSI, Automotive,



AI/ML, Data Science, mainframe,Software Technologies to deliver customized, outcome-driven learning programs.







Our Corporate Training Offerings;







  *   Domain-specific upskilling & reskilling programs

  *   New hire enablement & lateral skill enhancement

  *   Technology transition & cross-skilling programs

  *

Leadership & advanced engineering workshops.







Key Value Additions;







✔ Customized curriculum mapped to your project, tools, and business goals

✔ Industry practitioners as trainers with real project experience

✔ Hands-on labs, case studies & simulations

✔ Pre-training skill assessment & post-training evaluation

✔ Flexible delivery modes – classroom, virtual, hybrid, onsite

  *   Detailed Table of Contents (TOC) aligned to the proposed phases

  *   Commercials / Pricing for the complete program

  *   Relevant Trainer Profile(s) with experience in OpenUSD, Python, and 3D workflows



Program Overview



Phase 1 — Python Programming Foundations (3–4 weeks)

Goal: Build strong Python fundamentals and practical coding confidence.

Coverage to include:



  *   Python basics, data structures, functions, and modules

  *   Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)

  *   Package management and virtual environments

  *   Debugging and development workflow using VS Code



Outcome: Ability to write clean Python scripts, understand OOP concepts, and manage development environments.



________________________________



Phase 2 — 3D Modeling & Computer Graphics Basics (2–3 weeks)

Goal: Develop foundational understanding of 3D scenes and graphics concepts.

Coverage to include:



  *   Coordinate systems and transformations

  *   Mesh structures and scene composition

  *   Materials, textures, and UV concepts

  *   Practical exposure using Blender or similar tools



Outcome: Understanding of how 3D scenes are structured and manipulated.



________________________________



Phase 3 — OpenUSD Fundamentals (3–4 weeks)

Goal: Learn core concepts of Universal Scene Description (USD).

Coverage to include:



  *   USD stages, layers, and prims

  *   Composition arcs, references, payloads, and variants

  *   USD file formats (.usd, .usda, .usdc)

  *   Scene composition workflows



Outcome: Ability to understand and construct USD-based 3D scene compositions.



________________________________



Phase 4 — OpenUSD Python API (3–4 weeks)

Goal: Programmatically create and manipulate USD scenes using Python.

Coverage to include:



  *   Creating USD stages using Python

  *   Adding meshes and transformations

  *   Scene graph traversal and automation

  *   Layer composition through scripting



Outcome: Capability to build automated scripts for creating and editing USD scenes.



________________________________

Expected Duration



Total program duration: ~12–15 weeks



________________________________



Please feel free to suggest any enhancements or recommendations based on your expertise. We would appreciate receiving the TOC, commercials, and trainer profiles at the earliest convenience due to timeline sensitivity.



Thank you in advance for your support.

Hi Team,





Kindly find the requirement details below :



Please find the detailed requirement below. We require an advanced training program on CloudPaging (Numecent) for our application packaging team.







We request you to share the profile of an experienced trainer who holds valid CloudPaging (Numecent) certification and has strong hands‑on expertise in enterprise‑level app packaging.







Training Requirements – Advanced CloudPaging (Numecent)







Day 1 – CloudPaging Deep Architecture & Advanced Packaging Concepts



  *   CloudPaging internal architecture (Player, Server, Studio)

  *   Virtual FS, Registry, isolation layers

  *   Streaming/paging mechanisms

  *   Layered packages, nested dependencies

  *   Complex installers & multi‑component apps

Lab: Capture medium‑complex app, build custom‑isolation package, validate Player behavior

Outcome: Strong conceptual understanding of CloudPaging architecture & packaging models



________________________________



Day 2 – Advanced Packaging Techniques



  *   Handling services, drivers, middleware, legacy components

  *   Pre/Post scripting (PowerShell), environment overrides

  *   Paging optimization & block tuning

  *   Multi‑runtime handling (Java/.NET/Python)

  *   Add‑ons, plugins, chained dependencies

Lab: Create advanced package with services/scripts; optimize paging blocks

Outcome: Ability to package complex enterprise apps efficiently



________________________________



Day 3 – Troubleshooting Deep Dive



  *   Player, Studio, Server logs

  *   Virtual vs. physical dependency conflicts

  *   ProMon, Fusion Logs, Dependency Walker usage

  *   Stream failures, isolation conflicts, rollback scenarios

  *   Fixing crashes, streaming delays

Lab: Troubleshoot 4 broken package scenarios, fix dependency issues & streaming errors

Outcome: Strong troubleshooting confidence & error‑pattern recognition



________________________________



Day 4 – Real‑World Enterprise Scenarios



  *   SCCM / Intune / Citrix / AVD integration

  *   Multi‑site streaming challenges

  *   Regression issues in UAT/Production

  *   Handling incompatible & legacy apps

  *   Documentation standards & SOPs

Lab: End‑to‑end exercise (Package → Test → Stream → Deploy → Validate)

Outcome: Ability to manage real‑world enterprise packaging challenges independently



________________________________



Day 5 – Capstone & Assessment



  *   Complex real‑world packaging scenario

  *   Troubleshooting & deployment validation

  *   Best practices & performance tuning

  *   Automation opportunities

Assessment:

  *   Build 1 complex app

  *   Troubleshoot 5 issues

  *   Deploy using enterprise tool

  *   Submit documentation

Outcome: Final readiness assessment & advanced CloudPaging certification



________________________________



 Request you to please share:



  1.  Trainer availability

  2.  Trainer certification details & profile

  3.  Commercial proposal (final pricing)





Regards,



Chandana Jayakrishna

Training Operations Solution Manager

I recently came across your LinkedIn post regarding your requirement for 

a Data Analytics / Data Science Trainer trainer, and I am pleased to 

inform you that we have an experienced corporate trainers who would be 

an excellent fit for your needs.



Clahan Technologies is a premier IT services and consulting firm 

specializing in multi-cloud environments, DevOps, DevSecOps, SRE, MLOps, 

AWS, Azure, GCP, RedHat, VMware, Python, Agentic AI and 24x7 hybrid 

cloud operations. We help organizations drive digital transformation and 

achieve operational excellence to maximize ROI.



We also deliver customized corporate training programs across advanced 

technologies such as Cloud & DevOps, SRE, MLOps, AIOps, AI, Agentic AI, 

Generative AI, Building AI Models, and Advanced Python. Our trainers are 

experienced industry professionals with over 15+ years of real-world 

expertise, ensuring practical, outcome-oriented learning.



Clahan Technologies has successfully partnered with leading 

organizations including ACL digital, Ipoex Technologies Pvt Ltd, Oracle, 

  Publicis Sapient, Wipro, LTI Mindtree,  Shell Company, GainSight, 

Altisource, Kickdrum Technologies Pvt Ltd, Comcast, FSS, EY, Deloitte, 

Nihilent, EverNorth, Capco, Kyndryl -- delivering over 45+ impactful 

corporate training programs in areas such as Cloud, DevOps, DevSecOps, 

SRE, MLOps, and Generative AI.



In addition to training, we provide infrastructure support through VMs, 

Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), and GPUs, enabling hands-on, 

real-time learning experiences that enhance skill retention and project 

readiness.



I would be delighted to connect and explore potential collaboration 

opportunities to support your organization's learning and development 

initiatives.



Looking forward to connecting and discussing how Clahan Technologies can 

add value to your training programs.



Thank You,

Dear Team,

Greetings!

We have received a training requirement from one of our key accounts and are currently looking for an experienced trainer who can deliver hands-on training on PTC ThingWorx, along with integrations involving ThingWorx Navigate, Windchill PLM, and 3D visualization environments.

The client is specifically looking for practical, use-case–driven training with lab support, enabling their team to independently design, customize, and extend ThingWorx Navigate applications integrated with PLM and 3D systems.

Core Training Modules (ThingWorx):



  1.

Introduction to ThingWorx

  2.

Thing Modeling Fundamentals

  3.

Data Storage and Time-Series Management

  4.

Services & Logic Development

  5.

Connectivity & Integration

  6.

Mashup Builder (UI Development)

  7.

Events, Alerts & Notifications

  8.

Security & Permissions

  9.

Analytics & Advanced Features

  10.

Deployment & Administration

  11.

Hands-On Projects

• IoT Device Monitoring Dashboard



  *

Device → Thing → Value Stream

  *

Live charts and alerts



• Smart Factory KPIs Dashboard



  *

OEE (Availability, Performance, Quality)

  *

Mashup with multiple data streams



• Predictive Maintenance Solution



  *

Sensor data logging

  *

Threshold alerts

  *

Predictive model integration



• Asset Tracking Application



  *

GPS device data

  *

Real-time map integration



Additional Expertise Required:

The trainer should also have proven hands-on capability in the following areas:

• End-to-end application development using ThingWorx Navigate Framework

• Strong understanding of PTC Windchill PLM including data models, lifecycle states, business objects, and access controls

• Windchill–ThingWorx Navigate integration using OData / REST APIs and PTC best practices

• CREO integration for visualization and interaction with CAD data within Navigate applications

• Integration of third-party 3D visualization tools (non-CREO formats) into ThingWorx applications

• Expertise in 3D data handling, lightweight visualization, and performance optimization

• Experience developing role-based, scalable, and user-friendly Navigate applications

• Exposure to real-world enterprise implementations, not just theoretical training

Request:

Kindly share the following details at the earliest:

• Trainer Profile highlighting relevant implementation and training experience

• Detailed Table of Contents (TOC) aligned with the above requirements

• Recommended Training Duration

• Commercials (trainer cost and lab infrastructure cost)

• Lab Setup Details for hands-on exercises

• Trainer Availability for delivery and a potential client discussion

Hi Team,



Greetings!

We have received a training requirement on CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service) for one of our teams, and we are currently looking for a trainer who can support this program along with the required lab setup.

Please find the curriculum attached for your reference.

Training Details:

Training: CCaaS (Contact Center as a Service)

Duration: 16 Hours

Mode of training : Online

Preferred Timings: 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM

Mode: Online (Trainer + Labs required)

Key Areas to be Covered:

The training should focus on functional and testing aspects of CCaaS, including:

• Overview of CCaaS architecture and multi-channel communication (Voice, Chat, Email, Social)

• Queue and Workstream Configuration, routing rules, capacity profiles, and skills-based routing

• Voice Channel Configuration (SIP, PSTN, VoIP routing, callbacks, voicemail, automated voice flows)

• Chat Channel Configuration, automated responses, transfers, quick replies, and agent capacity validation

• Omnichannel interaction handling across voice, chat, email, and social channels

• Voice and Chat Transcription validation (real-time and post-call transcripts)

• Agent experience and capabilities including agent console behavior and interaction controls

• Case Management Lifecycle – case creation, assignment workflows, and status transitions

• End-to-End Workflow Testing Scenarios across multiple channels

• Security & Authentication Plugins for secure industries

• Omnichannel analytics and routing diagnostics dashboards

• Microsoft Copilot Studio testing, including bot conversation flow validation and escalation to live agents

If you can support this requirement, kindly share the following details:

• Trainer Profile with relevant CCaaS / Contact Center implementation or testing experience

• Detailed Table of Contents (TOC) or training agenda

• Commercials for the program

• Lab setup details for hands-on sessions

• Trainer availability for a quick technical discussion if required

This is an active requirement, so we would appreciate receiving the details at the earliest.

Looking forward to your response.

Regards,



Chandana Jayakrishna

Training Operations Solution Manager

Hi Team,

We have received the below training requirement from EPAM and request your support in sharing the relevant trainer details along with tentative commercials.

Training Areas:

1. IBM FileNet

Reference Learning Path:

https://www.ibm.com/training/learning-path/filenet-content-manager-56x-1033

Key Training Components:



  *

Core Modules: Content Engine (CE) Architecture, Process Engine (PE), and IBM Content Navigator (ICN)

  *

Administration: Object store setup, storage area configuration, metadata design, and security (LDAP)

  *

Development & Workflow: Process Designer, workflow creation, API integration (Java/.NET), and REST API usage

  *

Deployment: FileNet Deployment Manager (FDM) for application migration between environments



Certification Focus:



  *

IBM FileNet P8 V5.5.x – Administration (Exam: C1000-074)

  *

  *

SQL for DB2 (Core & Advanced) and Stored Procedures (SQL/NZPLSQL)

  *

DB2 LUW Performance & Optimization (Indexing, Performance Tuning, etc.)

  *

Data Engineering–centric topics including ETL utilities (LOAD, INGEST, EXPORT), complex data transformations, cleansing, and enrichment

  *

Integration with data pipelines (Spark, Kafka, ELT tools)

  *

DB2 Warehouse concepts and advanced topics including DB2 BLU, WLM, modern integrations, and Cloud DB2 on Kubernetes/Azure

  *

Backup, Recovery, and HADR

  *

Security and Governance

  *

Automation and Diagnostics

  *

DB2WH Certification Path and guidance for certification preparation

Dear Team,



We have a training requirement for Cross File Transfer (CFT) and would like to check if you can support this.



Please find the details below:



Training Topic: Cross File Transfer (CFT)

Objective: Enable participants to handle and resolve L3 Admin-related issues

Current Knowledge Level: Beginner

Expected Knowledge Level: Master

Number of Participants: 15–20





Below is the topics to be covered. Can you check on this and share appropriate trainer profiles.







 L1 – Operations:



  *   Axway CFT tool overview

  *   How CFT file transfers work (PeSIT-based)

  *   Monitoring (queues, dashboards)

  *   Restart/resend processes

  *   Daily operational support tasks

  *   Basic command/UI usage



L2 – Support – MUST HAVE:



  *   PeSIT protocol deep-dive

  *   SFTP/FTP protocol behavior

  *   CFT log analysis

  *   Error codes and troubleshooting

  *   Partner & flow configuration

  *   Incident handling (P1/P2/P3)

  *   RCA preparation



L3 – Admin / SME – MUST HAVE:



  *   CFT architecture, nodes, partners, flows

  *   Installation & environment setup

  *   Certificate management, TLS, encryption

  *   Network setup (ports, firewall)

  *   HA/DR configuration

  *   Performance tuning

  *   Automation scripting

  *   Integrations (SMTP, LDAP, ServiceNow, etc.)





Kindly share the following details at the earliest:



  *   Trainer profile(s) with relevant CFT experience



  *   Standard Course Outline (TOC)



  *   Proposed duration and training plan



  *   Commercials



  *   Trainer availability



Your prompt response will help us proceed further.



Looking forward to your response.



Regards,



Chandana Jayakrishna

Training Operations Solution Manager

We have a critical learning requirement for SAP trainers and request your immediate support in sharing the relevant details at the earliest.

As the majority of participants are fresh trainees, we expect to conduct basic to in-depth, hands-on training. Each module is planned for 18 days of full-day, in-person training.

Training Expectations

Please note the following mandatory expectations for all modules:



  *   ECC and S/4HANA coverage, with a clear comparison and understanding of ECC vs. S/4HANA changes

  *   Minimum 50% daily hands-on training (approx. 4 hours), including:

     *   Topic-wise exercises

     *   Real-time use cases

     *   Assignments and practice scenarios

  *   Assessments:

     *   Intermediate tests twice weekly

     *   One final exit test

  *   Daily trainer feedback on each associate’s performance, along with daily attendance tracking

  *

By the end of the training, associates should be project-ready and prepared for external certifications

Dear Trainer/Vendor,

We have an urgent requirement for a SAP Activate training session as part of a 3-day Project Management program. The SAP Activate module will be a ~4-hour enablement session, and we are looking for a highly experienced trainer to support this requirement.

Program Context:



  *   Audience: Senior Project Managers (5+ years experience)

  *   Background: Prior exposure to SAP projects with basic understanding of SAP Activate

  *   Objective: Enable participants to connect SAP Activate methodology with Project Management (PMP concepts) and apply it in real-world scenarios



Scope of the Session:

The session should be practical, scenario-based, and industry-aligned, covering:



  *   High-level overview of SAP ecosystem (key products & deployment models – Public vs Private Cloud)

  *   SAP Activate methodology (Discover to Deploy) – focused on relevance to Project Managers (no deep technical deep dive)

  *   Differences between Public vs Private Cloud implementations (roles, responsibilities, execution approach)

  *   Impact of cloud model on project delivery (SAP vs SI dependency)

  *   Overview of SAP project types:

     *   Greenfield

     *   Brownfield

     *   Bluefield

     *   Upgrade

     *   Public Cloud

  *   High-level understanding of deliverables across phases and ownership (SAP / SI / Client)

  *   SAP tools, roadmaps, accelerators, and engagement models

  *   Practical project management application (planning, execution, governance using Activate)

  *   Common pitfalls and real-world challenges in SAP implementations



Key Expectations:



  *   Trainer should prepare 6–8 hours of content, to be curated into a focused 4-hour session

  *   Delivery should be highly practical, use-case driven, and aligned with industry best practices

  *   Not a standard/beginner SAP Activate course



Request you to share the following details:



  *   Trainer profile with relevant SAP Activate + Project Management experience

  *   Approach for delivering this customized session

  *   Commercials (per hour / per session cost)

  *   Availability for delivery



Given the urgency, we request you to share suitable profiles and details at the earliest.

Role: Master Trainer – Java Full Stack / Java & .NET Full Stack

Location: Trivandrum

Batch Start Date: 20th April

Engagement: 6 months contract

Commercials:



 *

₹2.8 Lakhs per month(We can negotiate a bit if the profile is really good)

 *   Travel & Accommodation will not be provided

 *   However, we can assist in identifying budget-friendly accommodation in Trivandrum



Job Description – Master Trainer (Java & .NET Full Stack)

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly experienced Master Trainer with strong expertise in Java Full Stack or both Java & .NET Full Stack technologies to deliver enterprise-level training programs for corporate learners.

The trainer will be responsible for driving end-to-end program delivery, technical depth, and learning outcomes through hands-on, project-driven training approaches.

Key Responsibilities



 *   Deliver end-to-end full stack training programs (Java / .NET)

 *   Conduct hands-on sessions with real-time project implementations

 *   Design and customize industry-aligned curriculum

 *   Mentor learners through coding, debugging, and architecture guidance

 *   Conduct code reviews, assessments, and capstone evaluations

 *   Collaborate with internal teams and provide regular progress updates



Core Technical Skills Required

Java Full Stack:



 *   Core Java, Advanced Java

 *   Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security

 *   REST APIs & Microservices Architecture

 *   Hibernate / JPA



.NET Full Stack (Good to Have / Preferred):



 *   C#, .NET Core / .NET 6+

 *   ASP.NET Core, Web API, MVC



Frontend:



 *   Angular / ReactJS

 *   HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript / TypeScript



Architecture & Development:



 *   Microservices & distributed systems

 *   API integrations and scalable application design



DevOps & Deployment:



 *   CI/CD (Jenkins / Azure DevOps / GitLab CI)

 *   Docker (basic exposure preferred)



Database:



 *   SQL (MySQL / SQL Server / PostgreSQL)

 *   Database design & optimization



Mandatory Experience



 *   10+ years of experience in development and/or corporate training

 *   Strong experience in delivering enterprise training programs

 *   Experience handling corporate lateral and fresher batches

 *   Ability to drive project-based, outcome-oriented training



Key Expectations



 *   Strong hands-on coding expertise

 *   Ability to explain complex concepts in a structured manner

 *   Experience in building industry-ready developers

 *   Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills



We are working on tight timelines, so request you to share relevant profiles at the earliest.

Manage access 

There are a few ways your data and configuration can be accessed in Atlas:

 * 
Database users <https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/database-users/> 
provide programmatic access to data in your cluster. This is useful for 
applications using drivers and our developer tools.

 * Atlas users <https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/access/manage-org-users/> 
are accounts for people on your team. You invite them to your Organization or 
Project oncloud.mongodb.com <> to manage the Atlas UI, review billing, and use 
the data explorer to view data in your clusters.

<https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/configure-api-access/> allows Service

### 1137. How to st uctu e you  Mo goDB data fo  speed

- Messages: 1
- Dates: 2026-04-16 18:30 IST ? 2026-04-16 18:30 IST

#### Message 1 ? 2026-04-16 18:30 IST

**From:** MongoDB <mongodb@team.mongodb.com>  
**To:** Anu udayam <annapurna@clahantechnologies.com>  
**Folder:** INBOX

Learn the basics of schema design, data types, and optimization.





Hi Anu,



The inherent flexibility of MongoDB's document model makes the initial setup 
easy. However, the performance and scalability of your application depend 
significantly on how you structure your data.


Start modeling  
<https://cloud.mongodb.com/go?l=https%3A%2F%2Fcloud.mongodb.com%2Fv2%23%2Forg%2F%3Corganization%3E%2Fprojects>

Data modeling for high performance

In MongoDB, you can model data in JSON the same way you do in code, as 
intuitive objects. Unlike in relational approaches, optimizing for performance 
in MongoDB follows a few simple guidelines.

 * 
When to embed data 
<https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/data-modeling/concepts/embedding-vs-references/#embedded-data-models>
: Data that is accessed together should be stored together. For "one-to-few" 
relationships (like a user and their shipping addresses), embedding the 
addresses inside the user document is ideal. This improves query performance 
and enables low-latency performance at scale.

 * 
Reference data with one-to-many relationships 
<https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/model-referenced-one-to-many-relationships-between-documents/>
: For "one-to-many" relationships (like a product and its thousands of customer 
reviews), you should use references. Instead of embedding all reviews in the 
product document, you would store a product_id reference in a separate reviews 
collection. 

 * Avoid unbounded arrays 
<https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/data-modeling/design-antipatterns/unbounded-arrays/>
: Embedding thousands of reviews in a single product document creates a massive 
document that must be loaded into memory. This can hurt performance and risks 
hitting the 16MB document size limit. If an array's size is "unbounded" (it can 
grow indefinitely), it should be a separate collection and referenced. 

Refine your data model

Check out this 2 minute overview on designing your MongoDB schema:


 <https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IzQXyv1M9NI>

Use Query Insights to detect, investigate, and optimize in just a few steps.



 <https://cloud.mongodb.com/>




Hi Anu, 



Query patterns shift; your performance shouldn't. Query Insights gives you a 
clear, cluster-wide view of which queries are impacting performance.

Launch Query Insights  
<https://cloud.mongodb.com/v2/64f0d460ce4e047320892068#/metrics/replicaSet/6973fb74c881ef3df8b66e0b/queryInsights/profiler?fromCta=queryInsightsPage&metric=Operation+Execution+Time&since=1775061477206&until=1775147877206>

With Query Insights, you can: 

 * Identify queries with high execution times across your clusters and 
collections
 * Understand the impact of queries before and after adding indexes
 * Isolate inefficient queries involving specific stages like lookup or sort
 * Track performance trends over time to validate improvements


Check out this video for a deeper walkthrough on how to fix slow queries.

Mobile‑First Microlearning for On‑the‑Move Teams

###****Why you should consider microlearning**** 





**Boosts Knowledge Retention by 20%**



By breaking information into bite-sized "shocks," microlearning prevents cognitive overload and makes it easier for the brain to transfer data to long-term memory.





**Ideal for the Modern Attention Span**



The average employee only has **1% of their work week** to devote to professional development. Microlearning fits into those small gaps, making "impossible" schedules workable.





**50% More Engagement**



Short-form content mirrors how we consume information naturally, leading to significantly higher completion rates compared to traditional, long-form courses.

Regards,



Chandana Jayakrishna

Dear Partner,



Greetings for the day !!!



Let me have the opportunity to introduce CertED.



CertED Technologies is a premier EdTech solutions provider specializing 

in comprehensive trainer support services for both technical and 

non-technical domains. With a vast network of certified, 

industry-experienced trainers, we empower organizations, corporates, and 

educational institutions worldwide to deliver high-impact training and 

skill development programs.



We understand that finding the right trainer is critical to the success 

of any learning initiative. Our platform bridges this gap by providing 

verified, qualified, and domain-specific trainers to meet your specific 

training requirements.



OUR CORE OFFERINGS



🔹 Corporate Training Support: Technical and non-technical trainers for 

employee upskilling.

🔹 Academic Training Support: Trainers for college and university-level 

programs and workshops.

🔹 Vendor Training Implementation: Seamless execution of vendor-specific 

training programs.

🔹 Customized Training Solutions: Tailored learning plans aligned with 

industry standards.

🔹 Global Reach: Access to trainers for both in-person and virtual 

sessions worldwide.



WHY PARTNER WITH CERTED TECHNOLOGIES?



	*



Access to Certified Experts: Trainers with proven track records and 

certifications.

	*



Scalable Solutions: From individual sessions to enterprise-wide training 

rollouts.

	*



Multi-Domain Expertise: Covering IT, core engineering, management, soft 

skills, and more.

	*



Flexible Engagement Models: Short-term, long-term, and project-based 

trainer deployments.

	*



Quality Assurance: Each trainer is vetted to ensure knowledge depth and 

delivery excellence.



OUR TRAINING DOMAINS



	*



Technical Trainings: AI/ML, Cloud, Data Analytics, Software Development, 

Engineering, EV, Automation, etc.

	*



Non-Technical Trainings: Leadership, Communication, HR, Finance, Sales, 

Corporate Behavior, etc.

	*



Vendor Certifications: Microsoft, AWS, Cisco, Oracle, Autodesk, 

SolidWorks, Revit, and more.



ENGAGEMENT PROCESS



	*



Requirement Mapping: Understand your training goals & skill gaps.

	*



Trainer Selection: Match with pre-vetted, certified trainers from our 

network.

	*



Training Deployment: Execute sessions virtually or onsite as per 

schedule.

	*



Progress Tracking: Real-time monitoring and reporting of training 

outcomes.

	*



Feedback & Certification: Ensure measurable ROI through post-training 

evaluation.



NEXT STEPS



We propose initiating a strategic partnership where CertED Technologies 

serves as your exclusive trainer vendor partner for all your training 

and development initiatives.



We are confident that our expertise will help you implement vendor 

trainings seamlessly, reduce costs, and deliver world-class learning 

outcomes.

This is to clarify the discrepancy regarding the employee joining date and PF registration date for the candidate.

The employee officially joined the organization on 02-Jan-2025 and has been continuously employed since then. Salary and employment records were maintained from the date of joining.

The company had initially planned to initiate PF registration from the employee’s joining period itself. However, due to internal registration and approval-related delays, the PF enrollment process could not be completed during the initial months.

Additionally, during that period, the organization was not falling under mandatory PF registration applicability based on employee count. However, the company voluntarily proceeded with PF registration and completed the process subsequently. Accordingly, PF details were activated and updated from August 2025 onward.

Therefore, the difference between the employee joining date and PF activation date is purely administrative/compliance related and does not affect the employee’s actual tenure or employment status with the organization.

Dear Lokesh,

Greetings from Clahan Technologies.

We would like to formally share the requirements and expectations for the upcoming Data Analytics Training program.

Please find the details below:

Training Details:

Course Duration: Approximately 120–130 Hours

Training Location: KSRM College, Kadapa

Point of Contact: Michel – 8179147889

Training Expectations & Approach:

Throughout the training program, relevant training materials and learning resources should be provided to participants.

As discussed earlier, the sessions should strongly emphasize practical implementation and real-time learning. Real-time case studies are expected to be included on a daily basis to ensure better industry exposure.

The training methodology will follow:

20% Theory

80% Practical Approach

Practical sessions should be interactive and aligned with industry scenarios to provide hands-on experience to students.

Participant feedback will be collected every two days, and based on the feedback received, necessary improvements or actions will be taken. We request you to be open to suggestions and adaptable to ideas that can further enhance the learning experience.

Commercial Details:

Trainer Charges: ₹5,000 per working day

Total Commercials: Number of Working Days × ₹5,000

Payment Terms: Payment will be released within 10 days or earlier after successful completion of the training program

We believe your expertise and approach will make this program highly valuable and successful. Please acknowledge and confirm your availability for the same.

Feel free to contact us if any clarification is required.

### 1424. WAF T ai i g

- Messages: 1
- Dates: 2026-05-22 10:49 IST ? 2026-05-22 10:49 IST

#### Message 1 ? 2026-05-22 10:49 IST

**From:** Malathi Soundarajan <malathi.soundarajan@springpeople.com>  
**To:** "annapurna@clahantechnologies.com" <annapurna@clahantechnologies.com>  
**Folder:** INBOX

Hello Annapurna,







Greetings from Springpeople!!







 BIG-IP Advanced WAF Training for Security & Infrastructure Teams





Business Context



Our Security, Infrastructure, and Application Platform teams increasingly manage external-facing applications that must be protected from evolving web threats. Given expanding attack surfaces, automated bot traffic, API exposure, and rising compliance demands, teams require the capability to configure, tune, manage, and operationalize BIG-IP Advanced WAF effectively.



This engagement is not for generic product walkthroughs.

It is for building hands-on, performance-ready WAF operational capability to reduce incidents, improve response time, enhance threat mitigation accuracy, and reduce dependency on SMEs.



The training must directly translate into improved protection, better tuning, fewer false positives, and stronger incident handling.



  1.  Performance Problem (What we are solving)

Current challenges observed across teams include:



  *   WAF policies deployed but sub-optimally tuned, leading to false positives/negatives

  *   Difficulty understanding WAF logs, signatures, anomaly detection, or bot behaviour

  *   Reactive mitigation instead of proactive policy improvement

  *   Lack of confidence in troubleshooting live attacks

  *   Dependency on a narrow SME group for policy creation, tuning, and deployment



Required performance shift:

Teams must be able to:



  *   Independently configure, deploy, and tune BIG-IP Advanced WAF policies

  *   Identify vulnerabilities and apply the correct mitigation techniques

  *   Understand and respond to live attack patterns with confidence

  *   Implement bot defence, DoS protection, and customised signatures

  *   Operationalise WAF as part of standard security workflows

  *   Reduce dependency on SMEs and escalate only complex issues



  1.  Performance-Based Learning Design Requirements

The training must follow a 4-layer performance design, ensuring each session results in a usable operational skill—not just theoretical understanding.



Vendors must use (or enhance) the structure below.



________________________________



LAYER 1: WAF Foundations for Operational Readiness

(Understanding the technology, architecture, and security principles)



Required coverage (from uploaded ToC):



  *   Introduction to BIG-IP Advanced WAF, architecture, features, benefits Curriculum - Configuring BIG-IP...

  *   Web application security fundamentals

  *   WAF core concepts and attack surfaces

  *   OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and detection mechanisms

  *   BIG-IP security policy framework

  *   Inspection points: client-side vs server-side threats



Outcome:

Participants understand the purpose, components, and operational relevance of WAF in defending enterprise applications.



________________________________



LAYER 2: Hands-on Configuration & Policy Deployment

(Focus on policy creation, deployment, tuning, and integration)



Required coverage (from uploaded ToC):



  *   Installation and initial configuration of BIG-IP Advanced WAF

  *   Creating, deploying, and managing security policies

  *   Learning Mode vs Blocking Mode

  *   Traffic inspection, logging, and monitoring basics

  *   Integration with network/security infrastructure

  *   Troubleshooting misconfigurations



Outcome:

Participants can independently configure and deploy a working WAF policy.



________________________________



LAYER 3: Threat Detection, Analysis & Mitigation Labs

(Use-case driven labs to build real-world detection and response skill)



Required content (from uploaded ToC):



  *   Identifying vulnerabilities: SQLi, XSS, CSRF, etc.

  *   Using signature-based and custom rule creation

  *   Behavioural anomaly detection and tuning

  *   Handling false positives and refining policies

  *   Bot protection:

     *   Identifying bot traffic

     *   Bot protection profiles

     *   CAPTCHA/JS challenges

     *   Reputation & IP intelligence

  *   DoS and brute-force attack mitigation

  *   API endpoint protection

  *   iRules-based customisation for advanced defence



Outcome:

Teams gain applied experience in recognising attacks, interpreting logs, and adjusting policies quickly and accurately.



________________________________



LAYER 4: Operationalisation, Best Practices & High Availability

(How the team will run WAF in real environments)



Required coverage (from uploaded ToC):



  *   Deployment scenarios (inline, transparent, reverse proxy)

  *   Multi-tenant / segmented configurations

  *   Integration with SIEM/logging

  *   High availability & scalability

  *   Backup, restore & DR considerations

  *   File upload/download security issues



Outcome:

Participants understand how to run WAF as a stable operational component without repeated SME intervention.



________________________________



  1.  Program Structure Requirements

Total Duration: 20–24 hours over 4–6 weeks

Format: Virtual Instructor-Led Training (VILT) with hands-on labs

Cohort Size: 20–25 participants



Every module must include:



  *   Demonstration

  *   Guided configuration

  *   Lab exercise

  *   Realistic attack simulation

  *   Reflection on operational impact



No theoretical-only sessions.

Every session must produce a usable operational skill.



  1.  Success Criteria (Internal, Non-Certification)

We do not require any external certification or exam prep.



Success will be evaluated by:



  *   Teams independently creating and tuning WAF policies

  *   Reduced false positives and improved policy accuracy

  *   Ability to analyse logs and respond to attacks

  *   Confidence in handling bots, DoS attempts, and API protection

  *   Ability to modify and customise policies without SME dependency



  1.  Mandatory Vendor Deliverables (by 12th December)



A. Program Design Blueprint

Must include:



  *   Detailed design mapped to the 4-layer performance model

  *   Lab design and attack simulation approach

  *   Tooling/VM requirements for hands-on

  *   Session-by-session plan with outcomes

  *   Reinforcement strategy (reference sheets, cheat sheets, tuning guides)



B. Detailed Table of Contents (ToC)

ToC must be structured, clear, and aligned to:



  *   Foundations

  *   Configuration

  *   Detection & mitigation labs

  *   Bot defence

  *   DoS mitigation

  *   API protection

  *   Deployment & HA

  *   Best practices



C. Trainer Profiles

Each profile must include:



  *   Experience in configuring and tuning BIG-IP Advanced WAF

  *   Security engineering background

  *   Experience conducting offensive/defensive security labs

  *   Experience training enterprise security teams



D. Pricing & Delivery Model

Must include:



  *   Instructor cost

  *   Lab environment cost

  *   Reinforcement materials

  *   Optional add-ons such as extended labs/clinics



  1.  Additional Notes



  *   Training must be hands-on heavy, not slide-heavy.

  *   Realistic attack patterns must be demonstrated and simulated.

  *   Vendor must provide a safe virtual lab for practice.

  *   Content should enable participants to implement learnings immediately.

Hi ,

As discussed, ,we have received a training requirement to upskill associates on Intermediate SwiftUI mobile. The high‑level scope of the program is given below for your reference.

Request you to share trainer profiles with relevant experience in delivering the session at the Intermediate level along with course content , commercials for training and lab .







  *   State management — @Binding, @ObservableObject/@Observable, @EnvironmentObject, @StateObject vs @ObservedObject for clean data ownership across views

  *   NavigationStack & routing — Programmatic navigation with NavigationPath, navigationDestination(for:), and deep-linking patterns replacing the old NavigationView

  *   Sheets & overlays — Modal presentation, half-sheets, full-screen covers, custom detents, and alert/confirmation dialogs

  *   TabView & split views — Tab-based navigation, NavigationSplitView for iPad/Mac adaptive layouts

  *   Advanced List & grids — Swipe actions, reordering, sections, LazyVGrid/LazyHGrid with fixed, flexible, and adaptive column layouts

  *   Async/await integration — .task modifier, Task cancellation, structured concurrency tied to view lifecycle

  *   Networking & Codable — URLSession + JSON decoding, error/loading/success state management using enums

  *   AsyncImage — Remote image loading with phase handling and custom placeholders

  *   Animations — Implicit vs explicit animations, .animation modifier, withAnimation, spring and easing curves

  *   Transitions & matchedGeometryEffect — View insertion/removal transitions, hero animations across view hierarchies

  *   Custom ViewModifiers — Reusable, composable styling and behavior encapsulated as modifiers

  *   GeometryReader & Layout protocol — Size-aware views, preference keys for child-to-parent communication, custom layout containers

  *   Form & input handling — TextField variants, focus management with @FocusState, validation patterns

  *   Previews & testability — Preview macros, mock data injection, basic ViewInspector or snapshot testing setup

  *   MVVM architecture — Structuring ViewModels, separating business logic from views, dependency injection patterns for scalable codebases







 Appreciate  your earliest response.











Regards,



Sweta

Dear Ms. Kasi,

Trust you are keeping well. Pleasure e meeting you.

Reference your post regarding the requirement for an Organizational Change Management (OCM) Trainer, we understand that you are looking for an experienced facilitator with expertise in change adoption, stakeholder management, communication strategies, & corporate training delivery. Happy to introduce ourselves in this context.



Introduction



BlewMinds is a Russell Group founder driven organisation focused on Inner Transformation & Sustainable Change through Executive Coaching, Leadership Consulting/Assessments, StoryTelling & Capacity Building. We partner with organisations to drive behavioural change, leadership effectiveness, workforce transformation, & sustainable people development.





Coaching & Trainings



We offer customised interventions in Organizational Change Management, Change Leadership, Stakeholder Management, Change Communication, Leadership Development, Culture Transformation, & Capability Building.



Our programmes are designed to support organisations in navigating change initiatives through structured adoption strategies, stakeholder alignment, communication planning, resistance management, leadership engagement, & employee readiness. The approach blends experiential learning, practical frameworks, case discussions, simulations, reflection exercises, & real world business applications to ensure effective change adoption & sustained impact.



Facilitators



Mr. Sandeep Kochhar (PCC, ICF) & Ms. Vishwapriya Iyer (MCC, ICF) are Leadership Coaches & Executive Facilitators with extensive experience in Leadership Development, Organizational Effectiveness, Capability Building, Executive Coaching, & large scale transformation initiatives across industries. They have worked closely with leadership teams, corporate learning ecosystems, & diverse stakeholder groups to design & deliver impactful learning interventions.





Select Partnerships



Some partnerships include AbsolutData, Accenture, Adani, Amdocs, Big Basket, Boston Consulting Group, Comviva, Danske IT, eClerx, EY, Gainsight, GlobalFoundries (GF), Infinite Locus, Korn Ferry, Manipal Hospitals, SmartAnalyst & Tata Motors. Thank you for following up. To ensure we are perfectly aligned, I want to clarify my background: I am an Independent Salesforce Consultant and Specialist, not an official Salesforce OEM/Authorized Academy Trainer.



Because I am independent, I do not use Salesforce’s proprietary OMS435 courseware or corporate lab environments.



Instead, I deliver custom, real-world enablement based on hands-on project experience. I can design a  5-day OmniStudio curriculum that covers the exact same core technical competencies as the standard course, but tailored for practical project delivery.



Please find the details below:



• Updated Resume: Attached





• Custom Table of Contents (TOC): Attached is my 5-day OmniStudio syllabus. It covers everything from Flexcards and OmniScripts to Data Mappers, Integration Procedures, and the Business Rules Engine.



Day 1: Digital Experience Foundations & UI

• Introduction to OmniStudio Architecture & Digital Experience Layers

• Designing Dynamic User Interfaces with Flexcards (Data sources, States, and Actions)

• Day 2: Guided Business Processes

• Building Interactive Forms with OmniScripts

• Step structures, inputs, conditional visibility, and branching logic

• Day 3: Data Management & Integration

• Extracting and transforming Salesforce data using Data Mappers (Extract, Turbo, Transform)

• Loading data back to Salesforce using Data Mapper Loads

• Day 4: Advanced Process Automation

• Building complex backend processes with Integration Procedures

• Combining multiple data sources, HTTP actions, and performance optimization

• Introduction to Expression Sets and Business Rules

• Day 5: Deployment & Capstone Project

• Migrating OmniStudio components using IDX Workbench / DataPacks

• Comprehensive Capstone Project: Designing and deploying an end-to-end customer onboarding solution from scratch



• Technical Evaluation Availability: I am available for a brief technical call on Thursday or Friday between 8 am and 5 pm.



• Commercial Rates & Labs: My commercial rate for this 5-day virtual delivery is ₹1,00,000 INR per day, for a total fixed corporate fee of ₹5,00,000 INR plus applicable taxes (capped at 20 participants). For the hands-on labs, we will utilize free Salesforce Developer Orgs with OmniStudio enabled, resulting in zero additional lab hosting costs for the client.



Please let me know if your client is open to an independent expert for this engagement, and I look forward to our technical call.



Best regards,

Sangeetha

### 1725. Impo ta t Update Rega di g Compa y Ope atio s a d Futu e Pla s

- Messages: 1
- Dates: 2026-06-29 08:03 IST ? 2026-06-29 08:03 IST

#### Message 1 ? 2026-06-29 08:03 IST

**From:** "muralimohanm@clahantechnologies.com" <muralimohanm@clahantechnologies.com>  
**To:** annapurna@clahantechnologies.com, babu.dumpalagattu@clahantechnologies.com  
**Folder:** INBOX

Dear Michel and Annapurna,

I hope both of you are doing well.

It is with a heavy heart that I am writing this email to share the current situation of our company. This is not an easy message for me to write, but I believe it is important to be completely transparent with both of you.

Over the past few months, we have been facing significant financial challenges. During June, we were unable to generate the expected revenue, and unfortunately, we do not have sufficient funds to process salaries on time. I sincerely apologize for this situation.

At this point, I expect that salary payments for the month of June will be delayed, and I am making every effort to arrange the required funds. My expectation is that we should be able to release the salaries on or before the 15th of next month. I truly appreciate your patience and understanding during this difficult period.

One of the major reasons for our current financial position is that we invested a considerable amount in college training programs, but the payments from those engagements are still pending. We also invested significantly in project development; however, those investments have not generated the expected business outcomes or revenue.

In addition, we currently do not have active client projects, which has severely impacted our cash flow. Running the company requires a minimum monthly operational expense of approximately ₹2.25 lakhs, and without consistent project revenue, it has become extremely difficult to sustain the business.

Personally, I have also been dealing with important family responsibilities that require my complete attention. Because of these circumstances, I have decided not to travel for business development activities and instead remain in Bangalore to support my family. This has also affected my ability to pursue new business opportunities as aggressively as before.

After giving this considerable thought, I have decided to take a break from actively running the company. It has been one of the most difficult decisions I have had to make.

Considering the current situation, I would request that Mounika N and Mounika M begin exploring other job opportunities. I will communicate separately regarding their notice period and the transition process.

Michel and Annapurna, I would also encourage both of you to start looking for better career opportunities. I genuinely value your dedication, commitment, and the support you have given the company. However, under the current circumstances, I cannot confidently promise career growth or long-term stability. I do not want your professional growth to be affected because of the challenges the company is currently facing.

Please understand that this decision has not been made lightly. I am deeply grateful for everything each of you has contributed to the organization, and I sincerely regret that circumstances have brought us to this point.

Thank you for your understanding, your hard work, and your continued support throughout this journey. I truly wish each of you success in your future careers, and I hope our paths cross again under better circumstances.

If there are any updates regarding the company's situation, I will keep everyone informed.

Thank you once again for everything.

Warm regards,

Murali Mohan Mabbu
CEO & Founder
Clahan Technologies

Explore CX trends and lessons from across APAC

"Genesys"      <https://app.mktg.genesys.com/e/er?utm_medium=email&utm_source=eloqua&utm_campaign=FY27_Q2_APAC_EVENT_WebinarSOCXAPAC&utm_content=FY27_Q2_APAC_EVENT_WebinarSOCXAPAC_Series_Email_Launch&s=1260946616&lid=14653&elqTrackId=e7583e37ffde4f899b88657ad882adf0&elq=cc3835efe5a341e391a7c19c16059e38&elqaid=17456&elqat=1&elqak=8AF5C9F7FB19A9D89E9F6F66DC43AE310A02E138183DDE8CB912D7544170901D1A7B>            



AI has changed customer experience faster than most organisations expected.



Across APAC, leaders are investing, experimenting and building momentum. But momentum alone does not create better customer experiences.



The next advantage comes from something harder: learning from the region’s diverse markets and using AI to create a unified customer experience, anchored in trust, shaped by human understanding and enabled by a workforce ready to act.



That’s why we’re bringing together regional insight, global research and executive perspectives in the State of CX: APAC webinar series.



Across three sessions, we’ll examine:



•                                                    Why APAC’s AI journey is different



•                                                    Market lessons on expectations and maturity in CX



•                                                    How AI momentum creates unified, trusted, human CX



Because the next question isn’t whether to adopt AI. It’s how leaders make AI-powered CX feel connected, trusted and human.



APAC has the momentum. Each market has the lessons. The next advantage is agentic CX that creates a unified experience, builds trust, stays human and strengthens the workforce.



State of CX: APAC From AI momentum to CX advantage

Trusted agentic CX is becoming the next leadership priority.

"State of CX" <https://app.mktg.genesys.com/e/er?utm_medium=email&utm_source=eloqua&utm_campaign=FY27_Q2_APAC_EVENT_WebinarSOCXAPAC_Series1&utm_content=FY27_Q2_APAC_EVENT_WebinarSOCXAPAC_Series1_Email1&s=1260946616&lid=14663&elqTrackId=9e74ec72fef44c3cabc6d6290d6e9366&elq=9d40d6673c5a4e0192f7f37d06c1b001&elqaid=17511&elqat=1&elqak=8AF54C2F35BFC8806AC917513062BFD789DDB517DE807F07B51722922517FAF4E16F>        



Across APAC, AI adoption is accelerating. 



Organisations are investing in automation, customers are more comfortable with AI-powered service and optimism remains high. But momentum alone does not solve fragmentation across people, data, systems, channels and workflows.



Join Albert Nel, Senior Vice President APAC at Genesys and Anne Marie Hodgson, Senior Customer Success Manager, APAC at Genesys, to explore why APAC is becoming a proving ground for agentic CX and how leaders can turn AI momentum into a unified experience that builds trust, empowers employees and feels human when it matters.



During the discussion, you'll explore:



•                                                    What makes APAC's AI journey distinct



•                                                    Why consistency is becoming the next priority



•                                                    Why consistency is becoming the next priority



APAC has the momentum. Each market has the lessons. The next advantage is agentic CX that feels connected, trusted and human.

The Rise of the Multi Skilled Specialist

- In June, Athiya introduced FlowCoach—a workplace learning reinforcement framework designed to extend learning beyond the classroom through structured nudges, practical application and continuous coaching in the flow of work. - June was filled with engaging classroom conversations as Athiya delivered impactful in-person workshops for professionals across every stage of their careers—from individuals taking their first steps into the corporate world to experienced managers leading high-performing teams.

Adaptive.), continues to be one of our busiest practice areas, delivering AI literacy programmes while preparing organizations for a series of upcoming AI adoption initiatives.
